No. 2375/23 – TUESDAY, MARCH 12, 2024
EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)

Notice under Section 7 My Ref No.: DSWE/LND/2/F1/47. I, hereby give notice under Sub - section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following lands which are required for a public purpose.
Description of the land to be acquired:

Allotments of 05 Lots ( Lot No. 1-5) in Total Extent of about 0.1041 Hectare, depicted in Breakdown Map No. 830341 prepared by the Surveyor General, situated in the Grama Niladhari Division of Raluwa in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Weeraketiya in Hambanthota District in Southern Province.
01. Lot No. 01 Name of the Land: Urubokuoya; Description: Scrub; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: Need for construction of Raluwa Manumwatta Road; Extent: 0.0034 Hectare.

02. Lot No. 02 Name of the Land: Iriyaketiyahena; Description: Open Waste Land (abandoned Paddy field); Claimant: State; Original Claimant: Possess by J.A. Sumanawathi (Need for construction of Raluwa Manumwatta Road); Extent: 0.0276 Hectare. 03. by J.A. Sumanawathi (Need for construction of Raluwa Manumwatta Road); Extent: 0.0037 Hectare. All persons interested in the aforesaid lands are hereby required to appear personally or by agent duly authorized in writing before me at Divisional Secretariat officer of Weeraketiya on the 08th of May 2024 at 10.00 a.m. and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 01st of May 2024 the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said lands, the
amount of compensation and the details of the compensation of such amount.
I.R.K. Witharana, Divisional Secretary, Weeraketiya.
06th of March, 2024. At Divisional Secretariat, Weeraketiya.
